mira (Finance Manager): Quick policy note: starting next Monday we're changing delegated approval for small purchases. Pls RT if you approve team spend.
mira (Finance Manager): Effective 2025-06-02: micro-purchase threshold remains $2,500 but delegated sign-off allowed up to $1,000 without Finance review. Anything $1,001-$2,500 still needs a two-step manager + finance quick-approve.
ian (Support): small Q: does this affect virtual-card charges for event swag (usually $900)?
mira (Finance Manager): @ian: $900 fits under delegated sign-off. Use the team p-card, attach Concur note with project code, and tag the approver in Concur so they get the notification.
teresa (BizOps): If an approver is OOO, can we auto-escalate? We had a backlog last quarter.
mira (Finance Manager): Good point. Weve added an auto-escalation: if approver doesn't act in 48h it escalates to the manager-of-manager. For urgent infra/revenue items use "procurement:expedite" and DM finance.
payments-bot: Links: Delegated approvals doc -> https://confluence.redwood/procurement/delegated-approvals | Concur quick link -> https://concur.redwood/login
ian (Support): thanks — will update our runbook.
mira (Finance Manager): We'll run a 20-min walkthrough next Tue and drop a 1-pager in #general. If you're listed as an approver but prefer not to be, DM me and we'll remove you. :wave:
